pokedexEntries.bk: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

pokedexEntries.wh: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

pokedexEntries.us: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.

pokedexEntries.um: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.
